articles.title: Federal Circuit Affirms Noninfringement Ruling for Lowe’s and $25,000 Sanction Against Patent Owner’s Counsel
articles.description: The U.S. Court of Appeals for the Federal Circuit (CAFC) on Monday affirmed a district court’s grant of summary judgment of noninfringement in favor of Lowe’s Home Centers, LLC in a patent dispute over light-emitting diode (LED) light fixtures. The CAFC also upheld a $25,000 sanction imposed on the patent owner’s attorney for violating a stipulated protective order and affirmed the district court’s denial of Lowe’s requests for attorney fees under 35 U.S.C. Section 285 and sanctions under 28 U.S.C. Section 1927.
